confirmed.statement: All five recorded grades concern submitted writing outputs evaluated by blinded experienced professionals from the same occupations. confirmed.statement: Criterion 3 holds: originality is explicitly among the grades applied to participants' produced outputs, supporting the novelty construct for S1-O2. Average, overall, writing-quality, and content-quality grades are quality measures, supporting usefulness for S1-O1 and S1-O3-S1-O5.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 3, Method, output-evaluation paragraph; p. 4, Productivity, first paragraph; codebook sections 3 and 6.
